things.note: Plain straight dark bars stand in for cords; no rope texture, and two ends cannot be told apart from the other strands.
A cluster of crossing straight lines; it never looks like a tied knot and no loop or tuck is drawn.
One bar gets thicker and a small red ring marks the crossing; the over/under is not visible as a weave.
A different bar gets thicker with a label LEFT OVER; again just crossing lines.
A second similar line cluster labelled GRANNY KNOT; it looks the same as the square knot, so the difference is not shown.
Only the words SLIPS and a yellow caption; the knot does not visibly come loose or move.

changes.change: Right end goes over the left
changes.note: One bar becomes thicker and darker over the other; it does not travel across, it only restyles.
A label TUCK UNDER appears over the lines; no bar moves under anything.
A thin red ring appears at the crossing and the drawing holds still; nothing tightens.
Another bar becomes thicker; no movement.

changes.change: Tuck under and pull both ends
changes.note: The label TUCK UNDER reappears and fades; the picture does not tighten.

changes.change: Right over left then left over right, shown together as a full square knot
changes.note: The second cluster fills in alongside the first and the bars are alternately thickened.

changes.change: Crossing the same way twice gives a granny knot
changes.note: Labels SAME WAY and GRANNY KNOT appear on the second cluster; the two clusters look alike, so the difference between the knots is never drawn.
The word SLIPS and a yellow banner 'Same way twice slips' appear; the strands only shift slightly and nothing visibly slips.
